nodes.summary: For every fixed integer $k > 5$ and every $0 < \gamma < 1/2$ there is $c > 0$ such that every randomized streaming algorithm over $\{1, \dots, n\}$ with $s$ bits of memory that, on every stream of at most $n$ elements, outputs $Z$ with $|Z - F_k| > 0.1\,F_k$ with probability less than $\gamma$ uses $s \ge c\, n^{1 - 5/k}$ bits.

The source does not exclude the empty stream. It is excluded here because there $F^*_\infty = 0$…

This is the model of the source, Section 1, with one difference: the seed is not counted in the memory. That is the standard public-randomness…

System Sci. 58 (1999), stated there for positive reals, with the remark that `x₁ = n^{1/k}`, `x₂ = ⋯ = x_n = 1` shows it is tight up to a constant factor).

nodes.summary: For nonnegative reals `x₁, …, x_n` and `k ≥ 1`, `((∑ xᵢ) (∑ xᵢ^{2k-1}))^k ≤ n^{k-1} (∑ xᵢ^k)^{2k}` (the `k`-th power of the "Fact" in the proof of Theorem 2.1 of N. Alon, Y. Matias and M. Szegedy, J. Comput. System Sci. 58 (1999), which is stated there for positive reals). The proof is the source's: `max xᵢ^k ≤ ∑ xᵢ^k` and the power mean inequality `(∑ xᵢ / n)^k ≤ ∑ xᵢ^k / n`.

This is the regrouping behind the computation of `E[X]` and `E[X²]` in N. Alon, Y. Matias and M. Szegedy, J. Comput. System Sci. 58 (1999), proof of Theorem 2.1.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
